When I asked the original dentist to remove it, I felt they weren't happy, and after removal, I felt my tooth structure looked different from before, which caused me concern.
When I showed the dentist before pictures of my teeth, they said my teeth were "worse" than this, which made me feel uneasy.

Initially, I was treated by a different dentist who had appointments on Saturdays and Sundays, which was convenient." Later, the appointment was rescheduled to Thursday, which clashed with my classes, making it impossible for me to attend. This resulted in a change of doctor.
